# SD13-E3 deterministic Human Monk level 1 martial chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk level 1 chassis as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-1-only martial chassis baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later martial burden surface: no base-attack (3/4
# BAB) or base-save (good Fortitude/Reflex/Will) progression, no unarmed strike
# damage die or Flurry of Blows execution, no AC Bonus (Wisdom-to-AC) computation,
# no level-1 bonus feat grant from the restricted Monk feat list, no ki pool, no
# level-2+ martial progression. It adds only the minimum feat, equipment, and
# selected-skill posture needed to make the bounded level-1 martial chassis
# legible; the monk base-attack, base-save, unarmed-strike/flurry, and AC-bonus/
# bonus-feat burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix to name as
# still blocking.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:1
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:deflect_arrows
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
